prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Review an iPhone account-page segmented control. Read interface.md. Audit the supplied interface; rank verified findings and show corrected behavior. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iOS. It contains nine long unrelated actions, two segments remain selected despite a single-view choice, selecting Delete Account destroys data immediately, labels truncate to identical prefixes and keyboard/assistive users hear no selected state.

criteria.task_completion: Find five concrete control-fit/state/destruction/label/semantic defects and propose a bounded mutually exclusive view choice or suitable alternative preserving all required tasks.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the segmented-controls guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Find five concrete control-fit/state/destruction/label/semantic defects and propose a bounded mutually exclusive view choice or suitable alternative preserving all required tasks.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Find five concrete control-fit/state/destruction/label/semantic defects and propose a bounded mutually exclusive view choice or suitable alternative preserving all required tasks.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.

required_findings.description: Nine long choices exceed practical iPhone density and related scope.
Single-view selection incorrectly retains two selected segments.
Destructive momentary Delete is mixed with persistent view selection.
Selected state is unavailable to assistive users.

rubric.review_threshold: Find at least four of five seeded defects, including every critical defect; no invented high-severity finding.
